checkpoints.description: [1/2] Audio cycle: reload-completion voice/caption, failing-first test, completion pair and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: The reload bar vanished with only a bare reloaded event; no voice or caption confirmed readiness.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clear reload readiness feedback without changing the ammo economy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (event mapping only); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: clip data.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Ammo-parity and voice/caption tests; baseline/after hash comparison.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Reload cue proven: 111 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 8140px pair, same d7eb253d hash, clip 0.06s; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-22-reload-cue' completed successfully.
[1/2] Progression cycle: schema-3 capped run history, migration, RECENT debrief, failing-first tests, pair and same-hash death run

impact_assessment.why: Only last_run persisted; prior runs vanished and the debrief had no history.
impact_assessment.benefits: Run-to-run comparison and durable recent scores without touching gameplay.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: profile schema 2->3; dependency: none; concurrency: atomic save unchanged; state: history normalization/cap.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Schema-2 migration, six-run cap, persisted reload and debrief tests; same sim hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] History proven: 114 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 8844px debrief pair, history []->[1500]; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-23-run-history' completed successfully.
[1/2] Combat cycle: spread-aware reticle, failing-first gap tests, four-weapon pair and same-hash runs

impact_assessment.why: A fixed 8 px reticle matched only the pulse and misrepresented the scatter, surge and lance hip-fire cones.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each gun's crosshair now shows its real relative spread; no gameplay change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD draw-only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: juice DATA only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first gap tests, four-weapon staged pair with pulse control, same kite/strafe hashes.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Reticle proven: 118 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, scatter 576/surge 448/lance 256 px, pulse control 0 px, same kite/strafe hashes; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-24-reticle' completed successfully.
[1/2] Enemies cycle: vertical melee reach on the platform, failing-first tests, high-ground pair and played run

impact_assessment.why: A 1.0 m mite bit a player standing on the 0.7 m platform because melee checked horizontal distance only.
impact_assessment.benefits: The jumpable platform now protects against short enemies; taller enemies still reach it.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: melee damage changes for elevated players; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: enemies DATA reach_up.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first high-ground tests, ground/brute parity tests, highground played run, ground hash parity.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Melee reach proven: 122 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, highground hp 68->100 (4 hurts->0), 7276/7256 px pair, ground hashes unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-25-melee-reach' completed successfully.
[1/2] Levels cycle: readable wave spawn-origin markers, failing-first tests, staged pair and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: The sim emitted a bare spawn event and the game ignored it, so wave enemies materialized with no cue.
impact_assessment.benefits: Off-screen/behind-cover spawns leave a readable origin column for 0.7 s.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: game-state marker only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: juice spawn_mark DATA.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first marker tests, staged pair, natural kite spawns, same-hash parity.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Spawn marks proven: 126 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 386 px pair (126 in beam), same kite hash 4fe640c5; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-26-spawn-marks' completed successfully.
[1/2] UI cycle: center top-center status lines, failing-first width tests, high-score pair and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: Fixed x offsets made five-digit scores and long status labels drift off-center.
impact_assessment.benefits: The primary progress line and every status line share one centered axis.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD positions only; dependency: keystone.ui.font text_width (already used); concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Width-derived centering tests for WAVE/STREAK/OVERDRIVE/SURGE/BEST, high-score pair, same kite hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Centered status proven: 129 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 4724 px top-band pair, same kite hash 4fe640c5; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-27-centered-status' completed successfully.
[1/2] Graphics cycle: per-weapon tracer/flash tints, failing-first tests, four-weapon pairs and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: All weapons shared one yellow tracer and white flash, so fire had no weapon identity.
impact_assessment.benefits: Pulse/scatter/lance/surge fire read distinctly at a glance; pulse stays the legacy control.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: presentation materials only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: tracer telemetry (not snapshot).
impact_assessment.mitigation: Four tint tests, four first-shot pairs, pulse control, same kite hash.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Fire tints proven: 133 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, pulse 0 px control, scatter 882/surge 226/lance 62 px, same kite hash 4fe640c5; checklists: passed
